notes: Main source is the WEDC 2003 case report: FUTS wagon table (14 routes, 1,030 wagons, June 2002; route numbers 4 and 10 absent from table), Suzuki pick-up table (4 active routes), RTA urban bus table (7 routes). FUTS still exists (terminal outside Aminpur Bazaar, APP June 2026; FUTS overseeing a 2026 tracking app incl. registered urban Hiace per ProPakistani Jul 2026) but no current published route list was found. Wikiroutes has 3 crowdsourced Faisalabad routes (2018). Excluded: government Green e-bus routes (urdupoint 2025, safar.fyi), proposed PMA/metro plans, intercity buses (WEDC Table 2.7). OSM only has B-10 (14168850), not duplicated. Gaps: current (2020s) FUTS route numbering and ordered stops; Qingqi routes (WEDC says no fixed routes).
